stem: Priya plants a moong bean seedling upright in a pot and places it on her balcony in Chennai so that sunlight falls on it only from the right side. What will she observe after a few days?

options.text: The shoot bends towards the light on the right, and the root grows downward
The shoot bends away from the light on the left, and the root grows upward
The shoot grows straight upward, and the root bends towards the light
Both the shoot and the root grow straight downward

teacher.key_rationale: Shoots are positively phototropic (bend towards light from the right) while roots are positively geotropic (grow downward regardless of light direction), so option A is correct.
